## Rental collection follow-on, 1 November 2026

[Rental withholding and owner advances](tg-rental-withholding.md) adds the ordinary LPF100–101 collection job, distinct from annual property and income assessments. It has17 rule rows and two executable cases; independent source review is pending for this addition. All nine earlier Guides and previous review evidence remain exact. Later-law continuity, current forms, disputed noncompliance, credit excess and unusual payments remain held. All seven domains remain partial; no accountant attestation or authenticated filing is claimed.
